builds.title: Molly: one interface for AmberX, axHub and the Dev Console (Opus)
builds.detail: Brett, Nov 2 2026: combine AmberX, axHub and the console into one interface but keep them separate apps. Opus version named Molly at molly.amberxai.com; a Fable version comes later in its own build. New app apps/molly (own manifest, baked framework, shared assets) is a shell that shows each app at its own live URL in a kept-alive frame with one banner, one app switcher, one hub sign-in and the look from axHub. Hard rule: AmberX, axHub and the console are not edited and keep running on their own URLs exactly as now; the only allowed outside change is a frame-ancestors header allowing molly.amberxai.com, if needed. No embed marker, no takes, no hiding or merging their menus (same as the Patches rule). No plain axHub hub page, all data on axHub, no storage picker. Patches code is not touched (paused).

builds.title: xLayout: Molly as one app (one banner, app menu, nav, context menu, toolbars) + IDE panes + plugin toolbars
builds.detail: Brett Nov 2 2026 13:46 ET: Molly is whack. Create application menus, navigation menus, context menus, toolbars and a banner that integrate all the apps (AmberX, axHub web, Dev Console): only ONE banner, application menu, navigation menu and context menu render, covering the whole page; the user must not be able to tell it is multiple apps. New plugin xLayout renders it that way. A switch makes it IDE style: draggable, resizable, dockable panes. Plugin toolbars: from the plugin's settings, show/hide up to 3 toolbars and set each default location. A hook in those settings opens a Toolbar designer dialog: pick items from a list of every plugin and screen; each item opens in the main area or a floating window, or (IDE mode on) a pane. Right-clicking any toolbar also has a hook to open the Toolbar designer. IDE mode limits the number of panes and offers ~10 predetermined pane layouts with a preview before applying. Molly-only: standalone, each app stays exactly as it is. Replaces the queued 'Molly: one app' item. Rules: assets/tokens only, framework controls, settings level toolbar, plugin lifecycle, UI Review.

notes.text: Brett Nov 2 13:49 ET: the Toolbar designer is its own plugin, not part of xLayout. xLayout calls it through a capability service (e.g. axf.toolbar-designer@1).
Nov 2 21:30 ET: s3 pane engine is covered by Urgent build dock-engine (shared with MD Studio + Theme Editor); s7/s8 build on it. Don't build s3 separately.

s3 (pane engine) covered by dock-engine (Urgent, complete on branch claude/molly-fable): core/engines/dock.ts + DockHost. s1-s2 built on Fable on the same branch (xlayout@1, chrome@1). s4-s12 are the Opus phase: run from this branch after it merges.
Reconciler: branch claude/xlayout-opus (PR #252); PR #252; PR #252 names s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9, s10, s11, s12 done
Built: Fable s1-s3 branch claude/molly-fable PR #245; Opus s4-s12 branch claude/xlayout-opus PR #252 (merge after #245). UI Review waiting: group 'xlayout - Nov 3 7:28 AM'.

Layout picker: 10 preset pane layouts, preview before apply, pane limit enforced

Toolbar designer dialog: items from every plugin and screen, open target main/floating/pane; opened from the settings hook and right-click on any toolbar
